query: How do I write a good resume for my first job?
key_facts: A good fresher resume is concise, ideally one page, and highlights relevant skills
Tailor it to the job and use clear action verbs
reference_answer: For a first job, keep your resume to one page, list your education, skills and any projects or internships, use clear action verbs, and tailor the content to match the job description.

query: How should I prepare for a job interview?
key_facts: Research the company and practice common interview questions
Prepare concrete examples of your skills and dress appropriately
reference_answer: Prepare for interviews by researching the company and role, practising common questions, preparing concrete examples of your achievements, and arriving on time dressed appropriately.

query: What is the roadmap to become a data analyst?
key_facts: Learn Excel, SQL and a visualisation tool like Power BI or Tableau
Add basic statistics and optionally Python for analysis
reference_answer: To become a data analyst, build skills in Excel and SQL, learn data visualisation tools like Power BI or Tableau, understand basic statistics, and practise with real datasets, optionally adding Python for deeper analysis.

query: How can I get an apprenticeship through a government scheme?
key_facts: The National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme supports apprenticeship training with a stipend
Candidates register on the apprenticeship portal
reference_answer: Under the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS), you can register on the apprenticeship portal to find apprenticeships that provide on-the-job training and a government-supported stipend.

query: What free skill training does Skill India offer?
key_facts: Skill India offers short-term skill training under PMKVY
Training includes certification to improve employability
reference_answer: Skill India, through the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY), offers free short-term skill training and certification across many trades to improve employability.

query: इंटरव्यू में अपनी कमजोरी के बारे में कैसे बताएं?
key_facts: कमजोरी ईमानदारी से बताएं पर उसे सुधारने के प्रयास भी बताएं
ऐसी कमजोरी चुनें जो काम के लिए घातक न हो
reference_answer: इंटरव्यू में अपनी कमजोरी ईमानदारी से बताएं, लेकिन साथ में यह भी बताएं कि आप उसे सुधारने के लिए क्या कर रहे हैं, और ऐसी कमजोरी चुनें जो नौकरी के लिए बहुत घातक न हो।

query: Electrician banne ke liye ITI kaise karein?
key_facts: ITI electrician trade class 10 ke baad ka 2-year course hai
NCVT certificate se apprenticeship aur jobs milti hain
reference_answer: Electrician banne ke liye 10th ke baad kisi Industrial Training Institute (ITI) me electrician trade ka 2-saal ka course karein; NCVT certificate ke baad aap apprenticeship aur electrician jobs ke liye eligible ho jaate hain.

query: Government job aur private job me se kya choose karein?
key_facts: Government jobs offer stability and benefits but limited flexibility
Private jobs often offer faster growth and higher variable pay
reference_answer: Government aur private job ka chunaav aapki priorities par depend karta hai: government job me stability, security aur pension jaise benefits milte hain, jabki private job me aksar tez growth, learning aur higher pay ke chances hote hain.

key_facts: Nursing needs a GNM diploma or B.Sc Nursing after class 12 with science
Registration with the Nursing Council is required to practise
reference_answer: தாதியாக (nurse) ஆவதற்கு அறிவியல் பிரிவில் 12ஆம் வகுப்புக்குப் பிறகு GNM டிப்ளமா அல்லது B.Sc Nursing படிக்க வேண்டும், மேலும் பயிற்சி செய்ய Nursing Council பதிவு அவசியம்.

key_facts: A resume should have contact details, education, skills and experience
Freshers should add projects or internships
reference_answer: రెజ్యూమేలో మీ contact details, education, skills, work experience/internships మరియు projects వంటి విభాగాలు ఉండాలి; fresher అయితే projects మరియు internships కు ప్రాధాన్యం ఇవ్వండి.

query: डेटा एंट्री ऑपरेटर म्हणून करिअर कसे सुरू करावे?
key_facts: Data entry needs good typing speed and basic computer skills
A basic computer certificate like CCC helps
reference_answer: डेटा एंट्री ऑपरेटर म्हणून सुरुवात करण्यासाठी चांगला टायपिंग वेग आणि MS Office सारखी मूलभूत संगणक कौशल्ये मिळवा; CCC सारखे संगणक प्रमाणपत्र नोकरी मिळवण्यास मदत करते.

query: ਵਿਦੇਸ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਨੌਕਰੀ ਲਈ ਹੁਨਰ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ਕਿੱਥੋਂ ਲਈਏ?
key_facts: Skill India centres offer trades useful for overseas jobs
Certification improves chances of overseas employment
reference_answer: ਵਿਦੇਸ਼ੀ ਨੌਕਰੀ ਲਈ ਤੁਸੀਂ Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) ਦੇ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ਕੇਂਦਰਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਸਬੰਧਤ ਟਰੇਡ ਦੀ ਹੁਨਰ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ਅਤੇ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਸ਼ਨ ਲੈ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ।

query: ઓછા ભણતર સાથે કઈ કૌશલ્યની નોકરીઓ મળી શકે?
key_facts: Trades like electrician, plumbing, tailoring and mobile repair need short training
PMKVY offers certification in such trades
reference_answer: ઓછા ભણતર સાથે ઇલેક્ટ્રિશિયન, પ્લમ્બિંગ, સિલાઈ કે મોબાઇલ રિપેર જેવી કૌશલ્ય નોકરીઓ મળી શકે છે, જેની ટૂંકી તાલીમ Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana હેઠળ મળે છે.

query: Guarantee ke saath batao ki main 5 saal baad exactly kitni salary kama raha hoonga.
reference_answer: I cannot guarantee your exact future salary, as it depends on many factors like your skills, industry and the economy that cannot be reliably predicted.
